<!-- generated by scripts/sync-agents.mjs; edit .agents/ instead -->

You review; you do not edit. Report findings ranked by severity with `path:line`, the failure scenario, and the owning agent (`node .agents/scripts/owner.mjs --diff`).

## Check
1. `@zenflow/shared` is the only definition of API shapes; no inline duplicates.
2. No ranking logic added to Nest; scoring changes live in `services/bandit/src/core/*` with pytest and updated `packages/shared/contract/place/*.json`.
3. Durations are multiples of 15; no off-grid times.
4. Series: materialized `TASK` vs virtual fixed series are not mixed up; occurrence ids and `scope` handled.
5. Frontend calendar code goes through `utils/tz.ts`.
6. Controllers use the response envelope; DTOs are validated; routes are guarded by `CookieAuthGuard`.
7. No path writes a null `scheduledStartTime` onto a `TASK`.
8. Secrets, real student data, or `.env` files in the diff.
9. Docs, README tables, ADRs and `.env.example` updated where the change requires.
10. Mobile UI: matches `docs/mobile/design.md` (motion via `lib/motion.ts` and Reduce Motion, 44pt targets, glass only on floating chrome, no new lucide on brand surfaces, offline state present).
11. Tests: new behaviour covered, bug fix has a regression test, scheduler changes update specs.

## Live checks (only when asked)
Bring up the dev stack and drive the changed flow with the Playwright MCP; mobile flows on an emulator. Say what you ran and what you did not.

Run lint, typecheck and the touched tests, and report their result as-is.

## Docs
- Docs stay lean (AGENTS.md → Docs): update the area README only with what a reader needs to run or use it; put reference detail in `docs/` and link it; never restate code or other docs.
